# Checklist: ux
<!-- Generated by /hef.checklist -->
<!-- Branch: feature/007-onboarding-de-orgs | Date: 2026-09-27 -->

Two audiences see this feature: a **maker** refused at the quota, and a **master** running the
wizard. The public sees only the lockup.

| ID | Check | Dimension | Ref | Status |
|----|-------|-----------|-----|--------|
| CHK034 | Does the maker actually **see** the refusal text? Makers upload through the admin form — `/missoes` sends them there. T033 confirms in the running app that a 507 shows FR-023's full message, not a generic *"Something went wrong"* | [feedback] | FR-023, FR-024, T033 | [ ] |
| CHK035 | Does the over-quota state (CHK014) read as an instruction rather than a negative number? *"Esta organização está acima da cota"* plus who can act — not *"restam −5.0 MB"* | [error-states] | FR-023, FR-024 | ✗ found |
| CHK036 | What does the wizard preview, now that CHK002 shows there is no storage prefix? The **host** only. Showing an `org/<slug>/` path the system never writes teaches the master something false about where the files are | [feedback] | FR-005, T026 | ✗ found |
| CHK037 | Does a **long** lab name fit the lockup? `CITE BAURU` is 10 characters, and the logotype is sized in `em` beside the wordmark. A name like *"Laboratório de Fabricação Digital de Ribeirão Preto"* overflows the chip at the 390 px breakpoint. The short-name field (CHK001) needs a maximum length, validated at entry | [responsiveness] | FR-014, D3, T018 | ✗ found |
| CHK038 | Does the chip's **accessible name** include the lab's name? `LogoChip` already hides the visual lockup from screen readers (*"FAB LAB CITE BAURU is noise in every screen reader"*) and supplies its own label. That label must come from the same data as the logotype, or a screen reader announces CITe on every other lab's site | [accessibility] | FR-014, T018 | [ ] |
| CHK039 | When creation fails mid-way (FR-008), what does the master see, and is the form preserved so the retry is not a re-type? The slug is permanent, so the failure message must say plainly whether anything was created | [error-states] | FR-008, T027 | [ ] |
